Subject: Scouting discovery -> Evaluation kickoff proposal and calendar

Hi Emma / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed next step to get an evaluation started: 

Recap (high level)
- Primary use: clinical documentation assistant for specialty care (reduce note time, preserve fidelity)
- Key constraints: PHI-handling, on-prem option for audit evidence, 95th percentile latency < 500ms for short prompts
- Success signals you mentioned: accuracy on clinical extract tasks, reduced clinician editing time, stability of outputs across templates

Proposal: schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff / tech deep-dive to align on the trial charter, confirm success criteria, and pair product/engineering for prompt/eval handoff. Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 9/9 — 10:00–11:00
- Thu 9/10 — 13:00–14:00

Proposed attendees (please confirm):
- Avery: product lead, R&D/engineering lead (Tom?)
- Redwood: myself (acct exec), Ben Carter (solutions engineer), Kimberly Park (customer success / evaluation design)

Draft agenda (60m)
1) Trial charter overview (10m) — scope, data & security constraints
2) Tech deep-dive (25m) — infra, model variant options, latency/cost tradeoffs
3) Prompt set & evaluation plan (15m) — sample prompts, success metrics, data handoff
4) Next steps & logistics (10m) — calendar invite, prework, install access

I attached a short trial-charter-template.pdf to speed the kickoff.

Please reply with: preferred slot, attendees to include, and any other agenda items (security checklist, integration contacts, etc.).

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

—
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com
Attachment: trial-charter-template.pdf (application/pdf, 220KB)
